name: Riso Print
tagline: Two inks, one pass, happy accidents on purpose.
description: Borrowed from the risograph: a cream paper ground, two spot inks that overprint into a third color, halftone texture, and type that is slightly off register. It feels handmade and loud without being messy, because the grid underneath stays strict.

fonts.role: display headlines; use font-stretch 130 to 150 percent

palette.role: fluoro pink ink, fills and shapes only, never text

allowedGradients.reason: halftone dot texture that imitates a riso screen, used only on decorative shapes

do: Overprint pink and blue shapes with mix-blend-multiply so their overlap prints a third color
Offset one display headline layer by 2 to 4px in the second ink to fake misregistration, with the duplicate aria-hidden
Use the halftone utility only on decorative shapes, never behind text
Set display type in Anybody at wide widths and body in Courier Prime
Keep the grid strict so the playful ink effects read as intentional
dont: Do not use pink as a text color
Do not use more than the two spot inks plus ink and paper
Do not round corners except on circular stickers and pills
Do not use shadows; depth comes from overprint and offset
Do not put texture behind body copy

components.name: Button
components.notes: Primary is a blue fill with paper text and a pink block offset 3px behind it (overprinting where they meet). Secondary is an ink outline; ghost is an underlined text link.

components.name: Input
components.notes: Paper field with a 2px ink edge, typewriter label, and an error state with a pink marker block beside a blue-ink message.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Ink-edged select with a hand-cut triangle marker.

components.name: Checkbox and toggle
components.notes: Square checkbox that fills blue with a paper check. Switch is a pill track with a pink knob overprinting the blue track when on.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Pill stickers in blue, pink with ink text, outline, and one rotated sticker per screen.

components.name: Card
components.notes: A zine card: drawn cover with overprinting shapes, title in Anybody, page count and price in typewriter.

components.name: Navbar
components.notes: Wordmark with a misregistered second layer, links in typewriter, a blue order button. Mobile menu is a details disclosure on paper.

components.name: Modal and sheet
components.notes: Paper sheet with an ink edge and a pink corner block, title in Anybody, two actions.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Price list: stock, size, one color, two color, minimum run, ruled with ink lines, prices right-aligned.

components.name: Bento grid
components.notes: Poster wall: 2x2 overprint poster tile, a halftone shape tile, a quote, a fair date tile, and an ink swatch tile.

components.name: Empty state
components.notes: An empty tray drawn with two offset outlines, one line of copy, one blue action.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: Paper strip with a blue or pink square and a typewriter message.
